messages:
mina: Heads-up — I'm opening a tiny docs hotfix to add the incident/status link and a short workaround for the token-refresh 401s we saw. Tagging reviewers.

rajesh: can you paste the status URL and the exact copy you want in the doc? comms asked we avoid the word 'outage' in customer-facing docs.

mina: status: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-11-token-refresh
Proposed copy: "Temporary mitigation: If you observe intermittent 401s on long-running streams after the incident, call the token refresh endpoint and then re-open your stream. This is a temporary mitigation while engineering rolls out a permanent fix."

support: please include short examples for JS and curl so we can point customers to snippets in support replies.

mina: adding both. JS minimal: `await client.auth.refreshToken()` then re-open stream. curl:
```
curl -X POST \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN" \\\n  https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/refresh \\\n  -d '{"grant_type":"refresh_token","refresh_token":"REPLACE_ME"}'
```

ci-bot: build started for PR #6301 - job: ci/docs-preview.

mina: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6301 - includes md change + snippets + frontmatter tag `hotfixes: ["incident-2026-11-token-refresh"]`. Preview: https://deploy-preview-6301--docs.redwood.example/incident-token-refresh-mitigation

ci-bot: build failed for PR #6301 - error: docs-linter/frontmatter: missing required key `hotfixes` in frontmatter.

mina: odd, I added it. pushing fix.

ci-bot: build queued for PR #6301.

ci-bot: build failed for PR #6301 - error: docs-linter/links: broken link to /guides/auth-old-pattern (404).

rajesh: that link was a leftover reference to the deprecated auth guide. please remove it from the hotfix branch; don't try to update old guides in this hotfix.

mina: removed the broken link and pushed. build retriggering.

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR #6301 - preview available: https://deploy-preview-6301--docs.redwood.example/incident-token-refresh-mitigation

rajesh: quick pass — small nit: add language tag to the JS fence so it renders. otherwise looks good.

mina: fixed, pushed.

rajesh: approved. merging now so support has the doc for morning shift. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: PR #6301 merged into main by mina (docs).

mina: opening follow-up to cherry-pick into release/2026-11 and to add an internal support KB link. @support please add a runbook note referencing these snippets.

support: will add KB and paste the curl/JS examples. will link KB in the cherry-pick PR.

statusbot: Incident 2026-11 token refresh - mitigation documented. Postmortem link pending: https://status.redwood.example/postmortem/2026-11-token-refresh

mina: thanks everyone. if any customers report variants of the 401s, add detail to the KB and we'll update the public doc with any additional mitigations.
